name: Replica
summary: 由高质量真实室内重建组成的三维场景数据集，提供纹理网格、语义和高保真渲染资产，常用于具身导航与神经场景表示。
summaryEn: A set of high-quality reconstructed indoor scenes with textured meshes, semantics, and photorealistic assets for embodied navigation and neural scene representations.
license: Replica Dataset License; non-commercial research restrictions apply
licenseZh: 适用 Replica 数据集许可；包含非商业研究限制
wmNote: 场景质量高，适合渲染和导航；数量较少且原始数据主要是静态环境。
wmNoteEn: High scene quality supports rendering and navigation, while the collection is small and primarily static.
